note: The label is read off nested containment — the visible fact that levels sit inside levels. Standing and cut-generation ride along unmeasured. This is the weld that lets 'hierarchy is natural' run on the containment sense and cash out in the imposed-ordering sense.

components.name: nested containment
components.unit: levels of enclosure (a is inside b is inside c)

components.name: organizing abstraction
components.unit: categories held by an observer for sorting information, count

components.name: imposed ordering with standing attached
components.unit: positions ranked, with differential claim on decisions or resources

components.name: distance between where the ordering is established and where it is used
components.unit: credentialing interval — time lag and scale gap from origin to point of use

components.name: cut-generation rate
components.unit: new internal distinctions required per unit time to maintain the ordering

divergences.note: Dominance in some fish and reptile groups: traits favoured in that environment produce the dominance, and when the environment changes, which being is dominant changes to suit it. The ordering is read off the environment rather than held by anyone. Nested containment reads present, imposed ordering is absent, cut rate is zero. Same word covers this and a credentialed command structure.

Roles assigned by who was available, necessary, and trained — most skilled for the environment. Training director and field-team director were sometimes the same person when that person could be on call. Ordering established at the point of use by conditions. ordering_origin near zero.

Same function, ordering now established off-site and instantiated on arrival. Hierarchies outside the instance are initiated inside it. ordering_origin large; cut rate has only gone up. Nested containment unchanged between this and the volunteer case — the label does not move while ordering_origin and cut_rate move to the opposite end.

1900s surgical teams had little hierarchical ranking; 1960s-70s markedly different from present. Now surgical nurses hold certain credentials, support nurses hold other credentials, surgeons another, with more added over time. The transient in-theatre ordering looks unchanged; the credentialing structure it imports has grown continuously.

The claim 'hierarchy is natural' is supported by pointing at nested containment and at environment-ordered dominance, then applied to imposed orderings with standing. Both supports sit in components where cut_rate is zero. The application sits in the component where cut_rate is unbounded. No separate handle in English marks the switch.

open: cut_rate and ordering_origin are proposed measurements with zero collected series. The fire service is where data plausibly exists — volunteer through present, credential requirements documented and dated.
The read-vs-imposed criterion must be fixed BEFORE any series is run. Sorting cases into 'not really hierarchy' after seeing the cut rate makes the finding true by construction.

tracked_by_label is a judgment call here as elsewhere. nested_containment is the reading because it is what is pointed at in naturalness arguments; imposed_ordering has a competing case if the domain is taken as organizational practice rather than the naturalness claim.
